card.name: Verse in "Adverse Reactions" cross-references
card.fires_on: The piece "verse" in "Ad|verse" inside bracketed cross-references like [see Adverse Reactions (6.1)], at the end of a warning sentence. Weaker on "adverse" before "events".

modes.label: Cross-reference
modes.description: The word "Adverse" split after "Ad" in a [see Adverse Reactions (6.x)] pointer.
modes.example: including thrombocytopenia and neutropenia [see Ad<<verse>> Reactions (6.1) ]

modes.label: Adverse events phrase
modes.description: The word "adverse" before "events" in safety-population text.
modes.example: In the pooled safety population, serious<< adverse>> events of skin and subcutaneous tissue
